name: Europe hybrid attacks
summary: Estonia blames Russian military intelligence for a foiled arson at a drone maker; no casualties or major outage found
state: Estonia says Russian military intelligence ordered an attempted arson at drone maker Threod Systems and will close all its Russian border crossings from 1 Dec (UNN; SBS News). No one was hurt. No sabotage causing casualties or a major outage, and no repeated multi-country airport shutdowns, were found from 15 to 21 Nov, so Watch holds.
for_you: Follow local police and security service advice; report suspicious activity near infrastructure.
rubric_hit: Sabotage incident attributed to a state = Watch

why: Sabotage, arson and drone incursions over airports and bases are how state confrontation reaches daily life in the UK and Europe.
drivers: Russia–NATO tensions, drone and cyber capabilities, proxy recruitment, elections.

rubric.alert: Repeated airport or infrastructure shutdowns across several countries, or sabotage causing casualties or a major outage.
rubric.watch: Drone incursions close an airport or military base, or a sabotage incident is attributed to a state.
rubric.normal: No significant attributed sabotage or airspace incursions in Europe this week.
